description: deleteMailbox: Stage deletion of a mailbox. The mailbox stops working immediately and its data is destroyed after a 14-day grace period. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: deleteMailbox
